test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the son of B',

'A x B' means 'A is the husband of B'

and 'A ÷ B' means 'A is the brother of B'.

How is O related to Q if 'M + N ÷ O × P + Q'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 A is

 +
 -
 ×

 Meaning
 Mother

 to B
 
 

Given: M + N ÷ O × P + Q

M + N → M is the mother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8978a36456c53fca2f9b922093e4eb3554dcd5115f253445d1987e07f4fb2317.png] 

N ÷ O → N is the brother of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32458c15fdc8c390992c6b7aa387121753a1190923169dc3cf54cc40aa4b5fdf.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90c0ddfc096ca73b30e8a91f2da413d962c9416a8a4fa950b421d9960664dc68.png] 

O × P → O is the husband of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87da1e65bed5cedec13143fab21c9647ab5a50979534cf90e3117082fc5cf7ec.png] 

P + Q → P is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2238fb81b384af8783aef8716aec379bc2c2a2ae5c62b02fa5c1f1d84747e73.png] 

Thus, O is Q's father.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
